title: Ai-Travel Assistant
description: A smart Ai powered Assistant for smart travel recommendations like Hotels, Fligts, tour Recommendation based on Customer Budget.
challenges: My biggest challenge building the AI travel assistant was getting smart suggestions to work seamlessly with OpenAI, setting up a proxy server to fetch data securely and integrating Paystack test payments.
solutions: I tackled this by breaking things down using a proxy server to handle API calls safely, refining prompts for better AI responses and running multiple test cycles on Paystack until payments flowed smoothly.

title: Mibes Travel and Tour
description: Its a hospitality and Travel website that helps help you book travels from Ghana to Ghana and also from Ghana to different parts of the world.
challenges: Arriving at the exact design on the figma
Adapting to strict and tight deadlines.
solutions: Broke designs into reusable components, used Tailwind for pixel-perfect styling, and cross-checked every detail with Figma.
Implemented lazy loading, code splitting and caching strategies to speed up load time.
Prioritized core features first then iterated on enhancements and used task breakdowns for focus.
Used Git branching, PR reviews and regular standups for alignment.

title: Recipe Finder Application
description: This is a recipe finder application that help find meals based on recipe, make smart suggestions and direct you to a youtube video for better cook experience with that recipe.
challenges: Search Optimizations, Rerenders and Keystroke issues
solutions: Used debounce on search input and memoization (useMemo, useCallback) to prevent unnecessary rerenders.
Integrated Context Api for predictable state handling (adding, removing, updating items).
Built with Tailwind CSS grid & flex utilities; tested across devices.
Implemented React Query for caching, refetching and managing server state.
